design.method: 4 Williams rows twice +2 distinct sampled rows; then shuffle all10 using Python random.Random. Fixed before any formal timing.
design.balance_limit: Ten blocks cannot give exact4-position balance; counts2or3. Between-block transitions excluded because every condition uses fresh services and verified cleanup.
design.replacement: None. Preserve every planned ID and every attempted failure. No automatic retry or result-dependent additions.
design.block_admission: Do not begin a block without a fresh booking and full maximum budget covering all4 conditions, cleanup and quiet periods.

assets.policy: Reuse read-only assets; no conversion, model download or duplicate payload copy. Frozen per-file admission inventory required.
assets.storage_scope: Weight and metadata input files plus raw run outputs use qjhs003 XFS /dev/nvme1n1, same device as GLM assets. Shared checkout/.git, source overlays/ELF, control specs and claims still NFS; not all I/O identical. Device cache uncontrolled; local page-cache condition tested by mincore.

template.tokenizer: Kimi own tokenizer/template from accepted official SF reference; never GLM token IDs

correctness.native_transport: input_tokens -> TokensPrompt; no chat-template or OpenAI-only fields passed to SamplingParams
correctness.token_validation: Existing trace_debug get_current_tokens after responses: exact unique prompt prefixes and cumulative full prompt+generated IDs, output content/usage/finish match own SF gold.
correctness.observability: GLM actual requests logprobs=1 and return_token_ids=True; Kimi native SamplingParams receives logprobs=1 and obtains actual IDs via existing trace. Unsupported OpenAI return_token_ids/top_logprobs/stream/template kwargs are not passed to SamplingParams. Kimi explicitly top_p=1/top_k=0/min_p=0/n=1; GLM call omitted those fields. Kimi effective greedy behavior is verified from actual image source, not guessed; no claim that omission itself proves identical GLM defaults.

common_configuration.config_delta_from_L1: Explicit prefix caching false to align GLM; min_instances0 makes first arithmetic trigger startup. These are new formal protocol configs, not relabeling L1 timings.
common_configuration.jit: Fresh per-attempt empty explicitly located JIT/cache directories, same env for all4; record before/after. No hidden warmup request or shared mutable compiled cache.

cache_admission.disk_cold: Identity-checked frozen file list; file-specific eviction then all mincore pages==0 at admission. Kernel hint success alone insufficient.
cache_admission.disk_hot: Sequential bounded prefetch then every mincore page resident at admission. Incomplete hot state is admission failure.
cache_admission.pool_hit: Same authenticated Store instance, fresh exclusive log window containing exactly8 rank ToHost Finished-loading-success events. No intervening unload/ClearMem/eviction/extra load; CPU async ACK and manager bookkeeping are not residency proof.
cache_admission.store_cold: Use a fresh initialized Store with no host load, model allocation or queue before target startup; prove fresh PID/startticks and no target load events, rather than relying on ambiguous ClearMem ack.
cache_admission.scope: Local qjhs003 NVMe filesystem page cache; physical SSD cache uncontrolled. NFS remains only for shared source/control paths, not weight input/cache targets.
cache_admission.target_files: Frozen local inventory84SF and104Store files; metadata/payload counts separately retained; full Store copy SHA proof distinct from SF-existing payload stat proof.
cache_admission.missing_tool: RESOLVED: committed finite-list two-stage operation then residency query helper3340bf6a; CPU12 plus independent review. Real model cache operations occur only during approved guarded attempt.

events.concurrency: Actual events may overlap; only real same-clock intervals form exclusive stacks. backend init/route/first token are not additive phase spans.
events.identity: Capture boot_id, process startticks, container hostname, time namespace, monotonic implementation for each producer. Reject invalid cross-domain subtraction; keep wall clock separate.
events.primary_start: Same HTTP producer immediately before perform_http register, followed in that process by arithmetic; no parent Docker launch or polling in A.
events.ready_requests: Translation then fixed32 after first arithmetic has completed; separately report their request durations.
events.first_token: Backend first nonempty generation observed, not client stream TTFT.
events.fixed32: Actual32 generated token IDs and length finish; non-stream HTTP complete is not last-token timestamp.
events.missing: No per-token timestamp: TPOT and pure generation remain unmeasured.
events.gaps: Keep preparation-complete-to-register gap explicitly. Do not silently omit from contiguous total.
events.primary_end: received_ns immediately after arithmetic HTTP helper returns, including JSON parse and response-context close, before child gold validation/print; validated only after own gold passes.
events.parent_scope: Parent dispatch, receive, validation and persistence separate; event endpoints remain immutable producer timestamps.
events.cost_events: Controller-observed ENV/Ray/Store launch-to-config/initial baseline/API/delete/combined controller+API stop/normal CID exits/release boundaries; not pure CUDA/IO. Driver Store shutdown strict60 receipt remains distinct.

statistics.complete_pairing: Same source/protocol/node within each complete block, all4 conditions cache/correctness/ownership/release gates passed; incomplete blocks remain all-attempt denominator and excluded paired primary, never replaced.
statistics.test: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip of abs(mean difference), all2**n sign patterns, tolerance1e-12, Holm4 primary family alpha0.05
statistics.ratio: ratio of paired means A/B, not mean per-block ratio
statistics.effect_size: mean paired difference /sample SD of paired differences; zero SD marked undefined
statistics.secondary_cost_window: target preparation duration + primary duration for GLM definition, excludes separately disclosed gap; four secondary tests constitute separate Holm family, no combined8-test FWER claim.
statistics.contiguous_cost: target_condition_construction_begin_to_arithmetic_correct includes admission and prep-to-command gap; common initialization/prior cleanup/release separately itemized.
statistics.descriptives: All attempted success/failure counts and Wilson95; successful values mean/median/nearest-rankP90 with n; raw values retained.
statistics.power: n10 makes significance attainable, not guaranteed. No empirical power estimate from unqualified L1/AAB. Planned effect-variation sensitivity is conditional, not observed Kimi power.
statistics.stopping: Any failed attempt: preserve and stop block/study pending review; no blind retry, replacement or outcome-selected sample addition.

resource_budget.purpose: Hard ceilings, not expected times or measured throughput. Existing q3 AAB evidence cannot estimate full formal cold/hot preparation distribution.
resource_budget.guard: Reuse existing independent exact-CID guards + observer + root-owned bounded units; validate full block reservation/resources and each remaining full condition budget before activation.
resource_budget.during_timing: No Git, publication, synchronization or competing workload administration.
resource_budget.lifecycle: Every condition new head/worker/Store. Planned40 pool initializations640GiB,10 pool-hit preloads plus10 store-cold on-demand complete8rank fills; actual events counted, no automatic retries.
resource_budget.oneoff_scope: Observed copy plus fresh target SHA validation duration, not loader/model latency; source checkpoint payload not copied. Original conversion costs retained separately in prior receipts.
resource_budget.note: Configured upper bounds:7200 per attempt,28920 per4-condition block incl120 parent slack,289200 for10 blocks=80h20m reserved node maximum. Actual phase IO/system calls may fail; preserve failures, do not shorten quiet or add time automatically.
